name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Houthi missiles at Riyadh 10 Nov; Gaza strikes
summary: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on 10 Nov after a 9 Nov pipeline attack; Gaza strikes kill five
state: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed two missiles aimed at Riyadh, one aimed at the south and a drone over the Eastern Province on 10 Nov, with no casualties reported (Reuters via Cyprus Mail; Al Jazeera). The East-West pipeline was hit on 9 Nov, causing a limited fire, and Houthi-run media said Saudi strikes hit a gas station and oil company building in Sanaa on 10 Nov, killing one (AP). Israeli strikes and gunfire killed five people in Gaza on 10 Nov despite the ceasefire (AP). The Yemen–Saudi front sets the Alert.
for_you: Missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia and strikes in Yemen are frequent. Anyone travelling to Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel or the Palestinian territories should check FCDO travel advice before and during travel.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes: repeated Houthi missile attacks on Riyadh and Saudi strikes on Sanaa, 8–10 Nov
